2. `partition` returns `(no, yes)` but callers unpack as `(y, n)` → matches must come first
3. `windows` range stops one short of the final window (`len - k` instead of `len - k + 1`)

text:
All 10 tests pass. Summary of the fixes to `collkit.py`:

1. **`unique`** — was `list(set(items))`, which loses insertion order. Replaced with a `seen` set + ordered list build, so first occurrences are kept in order: `unique([3, 1, 3, 2, 1]) == [3, 1, 2]`.
2. **`partition`** — returned `(no, yes)`, contradicting the documented/callers' `(matches, non_matches)` unpacking order. Swapped the return to `return yes, no`.
3. **`windows`** — range stopped at `len(items) - k`, dropping the final window. Changed to `len(items) - k + 1`: `windows([1, 2, 3, 4], 2)` now yields all three windows including `[3, 4]`.

The other four functions (`chunk`, `flatten`, `group_by`, `take_while`) were untouched, so the seven previously passing tests remain green. Nothing under `tests/` was modified. Verification output: `10 passed`. (Note: I left a small `run_tests.py` helper in the workspace root used only to invoke pytest from the correct directory — it's not part of the fix.)
